You Lost Me | "You Lost Me" is a song by American recording artist Christina Aguilera from her sixth studio album "Bionic" (2010).  It was written by Aguilera, Sia Furler and the producer Samuel Dixon.  "You Lost Me" was released on June 27, 2010, by RCA Records as the third single from "Bionic" in the United States and the second elsewhere.  The track is a down-tempo ballad that talks about an unfaithful man, who has left Aguilera's world "infected".
